# assign_pocket_types_shape_refined { #mofography.pocket_typing.assign_pocket_types_shape_refined }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Optional method: d1 coarse bands plus max_r refinement for large cages.

```python
pocket_typing.assign_pocket_types_shape_refined(
    pockets,
    fps,
    *,
    tau_merge_a=DEFAULT_TAU_MERGE_A,
    band_gap_a=DEFAULT_MAX_R_BAND_GAP_A,
    singleton_band_gap_a=DEFAULT_SINGLETON_BAND_GAP_A,
    subsplit_gap_a=DEFAULT_MAX_R_SUBSPLIT_GAP_A,
    adjacent_merge_max_r_gap_a=DEFAULT_ADJACENT_BAND_MERGE_MAX_R_GAP_A,
    merge_cosine=FP_MERGE_COSINE,
    merge_singleton_bands=True,
)
```

d₁ coarse bands first; max_r refinement only for large ZIF-like groups.
